mentions.name: LLM Coding CLI Tool
mentions.description: A non-agentic LLM-powered command-line coding tool designed to make navigating a codebase and coding easy and fast; the author prefers working manually rather than with agentic workflows or small primitives.
mentions.source_excerpt: An LLM coding cli tool, not agentic, not small primitives to make navigating code base and coding easy and fast. I won't say the future isn't agentic, but I'm still having fun doing it manual.
